summary: Your installation now owns its web app sign-in registration, not the tool that installed it.

new.title: The installation owns its sign-in registration
new.text: The web app's sign-in registration in Entra is now owned by the installation itself. When Invardia's Support app runs the install, it removes itself as owner at the end.

new.title: Registration settings kept correct on updates
new.text: Every update keeps the registration's own settings as they should be. An install run that may not change it says so, and the next update applies the change.
